verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no native rule engine or workflow automation in Productboard that lets a user define event-triggered actions. Webhooks only send change notifications to an external endpoint, which a developer would have to build automation on top of. MCP agent write access and automatic insight detection are adjacent features, not user-defined event-to-action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
